improvements.title: Improvements
improvements.description: Continuous improvement items from audits, incidents, and reviews. Supports PDCA cycle per NIS2.
improvements.helpText: Track improvement actions identified from audits, incident post-mortems, management reviews, and KPI trends. Each item has a source, priority, owner, and target date. This register demonstrates your organization's commitment to continuous improvement.
improvements.empty: No improvement items yet. Add items from audits, incidents, or reviews.
improvements.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this improvement item?

fieldDescriptions.title: Short descriptive title for this improvement action (e.g., 'Implement MFA for VPN access').
fieldDescriptions.description: Detailed description of the improvement, including current gap and desired outcome.
fieldDescriptions.source: Select where this improvement was identified: audit finding, incident post-mortem, management review, KPI breach, etc.
fieldDescriptions.priority: Select the priority level which determines the implementation timeframe (P0: immediate, P1: 3 months, P2: 6 months, P3: 12 months).
fieldDescriptions.status: Current status of the improvement: open, in progress, resolved, verified (effectiveness confirmed), or deferred.
fieldDescriptions.targetDate: Date by which this improvement action should be completed.
fieldDescriptions.deferralReason: If status is Deferred, provide the justification and expected resumption timeline.
fieldDescriptions.verificationNotes: Document how the effectiveness of this improvement was verified after implementation.
